scenes.title: Hicham rachète l'agence ASK
scenes.summary: Hicham Janowski celebrates buying ASK and toasts with the agents.

scenes.title: L'ordre d'Hicham
scenes.summary: The agents discuss the loss of Ramzy and Virginie Efira to Bréhier. Hicham orders them to steal Fabrice Luchini. Mathias faints.

scenes.title: En route pour l'audition
scenes.summary: Gabriel rushes Sofia Leprince to an audition and tries to help her understand her character.

scenes.title: L'audition chez Constance
scenes.summary: Sofia auditions for the casting director Constance. Constance insults her, and Sofia fights back.

scenes.title: Le chaman de Noémie
scenes.summary: Gabriel returns to the office. Noémie suggests a shaman for Mathias.

scenes.title: Le rôle de Dario
scenes.summary: Mathias talks to a young actor client about his new role in a film.

scenes.title: Dans l'ascenseur avec Hippolyte
scenes.summary: Mathias talks to his son Hippolyte in the elevator about his mother and personal life.

scenes.title: Gabriel défend Sofia
scenes.summary: Gabriel talks to the furious casting director Constance on the phone to defend Sofia.

scenes.title: L'amour et les affaires
scenes.summary: Mathias and Andréa confront Gabriel about the danger of representing his girlfriend Sofia.

scenes.title: Un secret au bar
scenes.summary: Camille, Hervé, and Sofia have drinks at a bar. Hervé reveals to Sofia the secret that Camille is Christophe Lambert's daughter.

scenes.title: La piste de Luchini
scenes.summary: The agents look for ways to contact Luchini. Hervé finds out he goes to a gym.

scenes.title: Rencontre à la salle de sport
scenes.summary: Andréa conveniently meets Fabrice Luchini at his gym and tries to poach him, but he rejects her.

scenes.title: La prime pour Luchini
scenes.summary: Hicham holds a meeting to demand younger actors and offers a bonus to anyone who lands Luchini.

scenes.title: Le faux casting de James Bond
scenes.summary: The agents hatch a plan to trick Luchini with a fake James Bond casting director using actress Linda Gérard.

scenes.title: La fausse Debbie MacWilliams
scenes.summary: Linda pretends to be Debbie MacWilliams and meets with Luchini, telling him he lost the Bond role.

scenes.title: L'appel nocturne de Fabrice
scenes.summary: Luchini calls Andréa in the middle of the night while she is trying to sleep with her date.

scenes.title: Une proposition délicate
scenes.summary: Gabriel asks Sofia hypothetically if she would let Camille be her agent to separate their personal and professional lives.

scenes.title: Une pause agent
scenes.summary: Andréa goes to Luchini's apartment. He tells her he is leaving Bréhier but taking a break from agents. They connect.

scenes.title: Le choix de Mathias
scenes.summary: Sofia tells Camille she will ask Mathias to be her agent instead of Gabriel.

scenes.title: Une nuit platonique
scenes.summary: Andréa happily tells Arlette and Mathias about her platonic night with Luchini.

scenes.title: Visite surprise de Christophe Lambert
scenes.summary: Christophe Lambert visits the agency. Noémie is starstruck, and Camille meets him briefly.

scenes.title: Le cadeau d'Hicham
scenes.summary: Hicham pressures Andréa with a gift to ensure she secures the contract with Luchini.

scenes.title: Dîner après le théâtre
scenes.summary: Andréa and Luchini have dinner after the theater. Things are going well until François Bréhier approaches.

scenes.title: L'interruption de Bréhier
scenes.summary: François Bréhier interrupts the dinner and reveals the James Bond casting was a fake setup by ASK.

scenes.title: Moment de tendresse
scenes.summary: Gabriel and Sofia watch a recording of a play together and share a tender moment.

scenes.title: Cartes de visite et confidences
scenes.summary: Hervé shows Camille his new calling cards and reveals he knows about Christophe Lambert, but thinks she just has a crush on him.

scenes.title: La fin de la lune de miel
scenes.summary: After Mathias ignores calls, Hicham fires Andréa for failing with Luchini and orders her to leave.

scenes.title: La nouvelle agente de Fabrice
scenes.summary: Luchini calls Andréa and decides to sign with her because he found the stunt funny. Hicham overhears and reinstates her.

scenes.title: Le grand frisson de Mathias
scenes.summary: Noémie confronts Mathias about his blackout. Later, Mathias has a secret romantic moment in a restaurant.
